summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held August 26, 2026, where shareholders passed all resolutions approving the voluntary conversion of its secondary listing to primary listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. No financial terms, prices, or advisors were disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update regarding listing status, not a special situation. The company will continue arrangements for dual-primary listing on HKEX and Nasdaq. No special-situation event; nothing to watch beyond regulatory effectiveness.
